text:
Maya R: Hey @Aisha — Acme just uploaded an invoice (INV-8291) for $23,450 dated 2026-03-15 but it didn't auto-match in Coupa. Vendor claims PO 45023. Can someone route approval? cc @Ben (Finance)
Aisha - Procurement: Thanks. I can't find PO 45023 in our current PO system. Could the vendor be using an old prefix? @Acme Billing can you attach the PO PDF and full line details?
Acme Billing: Hi all — attaching via email caused issues. Portal ref shows PO: 45023 (legacy format). Invoice ID: INV-8291. Link: https://acme.example/invoices/INV-8291. We can reissue if you need a different PO field.
Ben (Finance): If the PO can't be found, we need GRN or explicit approval. We can provisionally route payment but need GL code + approval authority. Maya — what's the project code?
Maya R: Project is PRJ-719 (SearchOps). Use GL 5002. Also vendor lists an "overage GPUs" line — need itemized breakdown before full approval.
Acme Billing: Itemized breakdown: base subscription $19,000; overage GPUs $3,750; tax $700. We'll push a CSV to the thread.
Jordan (FP&A): Heads up — this vendor is part of the pricing experiment. If the overage rate exceeds our cap we should flag for dispute before paying. Can someone confirm units used vs agreed rate?
Aisha - Procurement: I'll open a procurement ticket to reconcile the PO numbering. @POBot can you try matching PO 45023 to any legacy records and return the owner?
POBot: Searching legacy PO prefixes... Found potential match: PO_LEGACY_45023 assigned to ACME on 2025-11-02. Status: CLOSED. No active linkable PO. Recommendation: procurement to reopen or create new PO referencing legacy number.
Ben (Finance): OK — plan: provisional approval up to $20,000 pending corrected invoice + new PO. Hold remainder until vendor reissues. Maya please upload the vendor email thread and the CSV to Coupa as backup.
Maya R: Uploaded the email thread and CSV to Coupa. @Acme Billing — can you resend invoice PDF with a provisional PO field like "PRJ-719 / PO-NEW-TBD" so we can process the provisional payment?
Acme Billing: We can issue a corrected invoice within 2 business days. We'll include the legacy PO ref and update the PO field once you provide the new PO number.
Samir (CFO): I can approve provisional payment up to $20k pending the corrected invoice and new PO. Hold the remaining $3,450 for review. Please note this is an exception due to the pricing experiment.
Jordan (FP&A): :thumbsup: I'll run a quick usage calc against telemetry and confirm whether the $3,750 overage matches our logs. If it doesn't, we flag vendor pricing dispute.
Aisha - Procurement: Created procurement ticket PRQ-2026-112 to reissue PO and document legacy mapping. I'll update once a new PO number is available.
Ben (Finance): Thanks everyone. I'll queue the provisional payment and flag accounting entries with memo "provisional - pending PO 45023 reconciliation".
Acme Billing: Thanks — we'll get the corrected invoice out and include the legacy reference.
Maya R: Marking thread resolved for routing; will reopen if new issues come up. :eyes:
